Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Ordered two pillows, only ever got one](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6688428f8ea63bcad5f56201)

I ordered two throw pillows. I paid $21.95 to have them shipped - and that's not even "priority". I got one pillow promptly, but I was strung along on the other one for almost a month before I finally asked them to cancel the order. The pillow was still showing up as available/in stock on their website, yet they told me when I contacted them that they could not get it from their supplier. After I cancelled the order I had to ask them to also refund some of the shipping as shipping is a sliding scale based on the amount you purchase and it wasn't fair for me to have paid based on the full amount of both pillows.

I don't think I will bother doing business with them again as I think you should be able to trust that your order will ship more or less when the website says it will ship at the time you order it.

July 5, 2024

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Updated Jul 9, 2024

Hi Jennifer, thank you for your feedback and we are so sorry to hear that the second pillow from your order did not ship out. Apologies for the inconveniences that this caused you. We can see that our Customer Experience team supported you by issuing a full refund for the pillow. They also provided a discount code good toward your next purchase with us. We apologize for this experience with us, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help you with.
